purpose.summary: This is a medical receipt (claims) input processing program for the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system used by Japanese medical associations. It handles medical treatment act (診療行為) data entry, including insurance combinations, prescription sets, patient hospitalization records, and fee calculation. It is part of the JMA Open Source medical billing software suite.

notable_features: Large file (~625KB, ~14678 lines) indicating a complex production program
154 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram architecture
COPY directives referencing domain-specific copybooks (CPK02SPASCR.INC, COMMON-SPA, K01COMMON-SPA, K02SCR-SPA, ENUM-VALUE)
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for SPA (screen parameter area) files in /var/tmp/
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based IPC via flat files
Extensive flag and index working-storage areas typical of large interactive COBOL programs
Version history spanning 2000–2003 with many named contributors
verdict.notes: The file is decoded with latin-1 but the Japanese comments are likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly part of the open-source ORCA medical receipt system developed by JMA (Japan Medical Association). The COPY statements reference copybooks not shown in this excerpt. The source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~625KB, so only the DATA DIVISION header is visible, but all structural indicators confirm genuine production COBOL.
